player_prompt.intro:
Yin e raan {player_id} ({role}) ee tuŋ tuŋ ciɛl Matching Pennies ee {num_rounds}.
- Tuŋ kɔɔr, kuɛth [heads] kuɛth [tails] (kuɛth [h], [t]).
- Na cieŋ raan yɔɔk kuɛth ee raan dɛɛt, Raan 0 aŋɛɛ tuŋ; kɔɔr na kuɛth ee raan dɛɛt, Raan 1 aŋɛɛ tuŋ.
Kuɛth yɔɔk ee ciɛl '[heads]' kuɛth '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kɛmɛtɛŋ cieŋ; yen ee cɔl '[heads]' or '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Raan 0 ciɛl {choice0}; Raan 1 ciɛl {choice1}. Ciɛl -> Raan 0 aŋɛɛ
message.round_mismatch: Wɛtɛ 0 aci '{choice0}'; Wɛtɛ 1 aci '{choice1}'. Mismatch -> Wɛtɛ 1 ŋic

outcome.p0_wins: Ɛn ŋar ɛ 0 cɛ run ti̱ ŋuan tiam.
outcome.draw: Kɛn ŋar diaal ɛ mi̱ caa mat.
